headline: RapWire 24/7: Yeat, Wiz Khalifa, Yung Miami, DaBaby and GTA VI
body: RapWire's verified Oct. 24 evening carousel covers Yeat's surprise tape, Wiz Khalifa's 10K Projects deal, Yung Miami's on-record denial, DaBaby and DaniLeigh's custody agreement, and GTA VI beer-label filings. Every slide uses original subject-led late-1980s editorial comic art with complete readable reporting, no top banner and the official transparent RapWire mark.

Every slide uses original subject-led late-1980s editorial comic art with complete readable reporting, no top banner and the official transparent RapWire mark.
caption:
1) Yeat (@yeat) released the 14-track Luh Leakyz Vol. 1 on Oct. 23, collecting fan-demanded songs recorded across different eras of his catalog. It is his third project of 2026 and extends the futuristic world around his Fortnite collaboration.

2) Wiz Khalifa (@wizkhalifa) signed with 10K Projects, returning to the Warner Music Group family for a new chapter led by the single “The Calm.” The move reunites him with former manager Marsha St. Hubert, now the label’s co-president, while an album is expected but not yet dated.

3) Yung Miami (@YungMiami305) denied in a new Breakfast Club interview that she transported drugs for Sean Combs. She said the allegation was false and addressed the personal and business fallout while promoting her solo era.

4) DaBaby (@dababy) and DaniLeigh reached a 13-page agreement covering custody and monthly support for their five-year-old daughter, Velour. The payment amount and parenting schedule remain private, closing a court fight that began with DaniLeigh’s 2024 paternity filing.

5) Public federal label records now show Pißwasser, Patriot and No Mames Vice City beers tied to the GTA VI world through Florida brewer Tripping Animals. The filings do not confirm a retail launch or a Rockstar partnership, but they point to a real-world marketing activation ahead of the game’s November 19 release.

@Rapwire247
